description: Arrange when animations play: reassign items to On Page Load or On Page Click, remove them, play them together or separately, and set delay, plays and loop (Timing panel)

delay.description: Delay in seconds after the previous item (assign, play_together, set)

event.description: assign: the event; other operations: only this event's list (default: the list holding each item, else On Page Load)

operation.description: assign (Reassign to On Page Load / On Page Click), remove (Remove Item), play_together, play_separately, set (delay, plays, loop)

plays.description: set: play the item's group this many times

target.description: Animated items (or media and multi-state objects) on one spread

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_timing
title: Set Timing
